articles.title: Nayara Energy Hikes Petrol By ₹5, Diesel By ₹3 Per Litre In Madhya Pradesh As Crude Oil Prices Rise
articles.titleEn: Nayara Energy Hikes Petrol By ₹5, Diesel By ₹3 Per Litre In Madhya Pradesh As Crude Oil Prices Rise
articles.summary: Nayara Energy has increased petrol prices by ₹5 per litre and diesel by ₹3 per litre in Madhya Pradesh, taking rates at its Bhopal outlets to ₹119.81 and ₹102.59, respectively. The company attributed the hike to rising international crude oil prices. State-owned oil marketing companies have not revised their petrol and diesel prices on Saturday.
articles.summaryEn: Nayara Energy has increased petrol prices by ₹5 per litre and diesel by ₹3 per litre in Madhya Pradesh, taking rates at its Bhopal outlets to ₹119.81 and ₹102.59, respectively. The company attributed the hike to rising international crude oil prices. State-owned oil marketing companies have not revised their petrol and diesel prices on Saturday.
